evidence.source: Wikimedia Commons file description (Ancient Chinese characters project)
evidence.text: The file page identifies 分-oracle.svg as a vector depiction of 分 in Shang oracle-script style and names Academia Sinica, hanziyuan.net, CUHK, Chinese Text Project, and Chinese Linguipedia as source references. It specifically ties this picture to Academia Sinica record 41.E3A4 and notes “前5.45.7 合11398 賓組.” The page states the glyph picture is CC0 1.0 and describes it as a modern vector representation, not an artifact photograph.

evidence.text: The database guide describes the collection as a searchable set of representative forms from oracle-bone, bronze, Chu manuscript, and small-seal sources, with provenance and form explanations. The general database page opened, but the character-specific record and a glyph image could not be verified in this session.

search_audit.query: 分 ancient Chinese character glyph oracle bone bronze Wikimedia Commons; site:commons.wikimedia.org 分 Chinese character oracle bone bronze; 小學堂 分 字形 演變 甲骨文
search_audit.outcome: Search found a candidate Commons oracle-script vector and a Western Zhou bronze-script vector, plus Xiaoxuetang database pages. Opened the oracle file description and general Xiaoxuetang page; the bronze file description was inaccessible.
No search results. An attempted click to retrieve the Commons original SVG returned a cache miss; the image itself was not inspected.

gaps: No glyph pixels were visually inspected in this research stage. The proposed oracle candidate is supported by its file description and source attribution, but its depicted strokes should be confirmed against the referenced record during visual review.
A direct Xiaoxuetang character record and its specific image URL were not recovered; no Xiaoxuetang glyph is proposed.
The Western Zhou bronze candidate's Commons description page failed to open, so provenance and reuse terms remain unverified; it is excluded.
The Commons oracle glyph is a modern redrawing in vector form, not a photograph of an inscribed oracle bone.

items.period: Shang dynasty oracle-bone script; approximate broad Shang range as identified on the file page
items.caption: A modern vector redrawing of a Shang oracle-script form of 分; the Commons file cites Academia Sinica record 41.E3A4 (前5.45.7 合11398 賓組).
items.alt: Black line drawing of an early 分 form, presented as Shang oracle-bone script.
items.selection_reason: The file page explicitly identifies the character and script style, cites a specific Academia Sinica form record, and states CC0 1.0 reuse. It offers a candidate for comparing the early graphic with the knife-and-separated-parts analysis; the drawing itself has not been visually inspected here.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication, as stated on the Commons file page; modern vector redraw of an ancient-script form.

limitations.text: Candidate identification and rights are based on the inspected Commons description page; image pixels were not visually inspected in this research stage.
